newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares may rise, but Wall Street weighs.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares may rise, but Wall Street weighs.

text.p: Brazilian shares may keep rising on Friday as investors should continue seeking out bargains after the market's recent losses, brokers said.
But some warn that U.S. stock volatility remains a key factor weighing on the local bolsa.
"The market managed to end firm yesterday because prices were attractive, but we cannot discount the impact of Wall Street," one trader said.
On Thursday, Brazil stocks ended higher despite a drop on Wall Street caused by renewed fears that U.S. Federal Reserve will decide to raise interest rates next week.
Telebras preferred up 2.83 pct to 112.50 reais.
Vale do Rio Doce up 0.55 pct at 25.79 reais.
